title: Urban Kayaks
specs: Paddle past iconic Chicago landmarks including Willis Tower, Marina City, Trump Tower
Sunset tours offer serene paddling with city skyline views and evening lights
All participants must be at least 18 or accompanied by a parent/guardian for tours
Must be physically able to paddle safely
Sign release of liability and indemnity waiver before kayaking
Must demonstrate prior kayaking experience for rentals
Single kayak rental minimum age 18; teens 15-17 with parental consent on guided tours; children under 15 in tandem kayak with adult
Single kayak weight limit 250 lbs; tandem kayak weight limit 425 lbs
Offers private group outings and corporate team-building events

blurb: Urban Kayaks offers guided kayak tours and rentals on the Chicago River and Lake Michigan. Tours include on-land training, life jackets, paddles, and guided narration of city landmarks. Rentals allow guests to explore at their own pace with included paddle and life jacket.
extraNote: At least 24 hours notice required for cancellations for refund · Severe weather cancels tours with refund or reschedule option · Light rain tours may proceed; guests can cancel 24 hours in advance for refund · Lakefront location may close due to high winds · No alcohol allowed before or during kayaking · Late arrivals can join if group still on land; otherwise must reschedule · Riverwalk location at 435 E Riverwalk Chicago, IL 60601 · Approx. May through October
